frappe-after-save-controller-hook.idiom: Controller hooks are validate, before_save, on_update, on_submit and the other documented names; there is no after_save.

frappe-cache-breaks-multitenancy.idiom: Cross-request caching goes through @redis_cache(ttl=...) from frappe.utils.caching or frappe.cache.get_value/set_value, never a raw Redis get/set.

frappe-cur-frm-usage.reason: JavaScript/JSON rule; AI fixes and recipes are Python for server-side code.

frappe-format-string-injection.reason: Exception objects formatted into translated strings; no product check. The eval scan counts any hit.

frappe-incorrect-debounce.reason: JavaScript/JSON rule; AI fixes and recipes are Python for server-side code.

frappe-missing-translate-function-in-rep.note: report-folder variant of the same rule

frappe-missing-translate-function-js.reason: JavaScript/JSON rule; AI fixes and recipes are Python for server-side code.

frappe-missing-translation-button-text.reason: JavaScript/JSON rule; AI fixes and recipes are Python for server-side code.

frappe-monkey-patching-not-allowed.note: partial: covers reassigning frappe request proxies; other monkey patches only by the eval scan

frappe-print-function-in-doctypes.idiom: Log with frappe.logger() or frappe.msgprint, never print().

frappe-query-debug-statement.idiom: Never leave debug=True on a query call.

frappe-realtime-pick-room.reason: A performance fix does not publish realtime events. The eval scan counts any hit.

frappe-redis-flush.reason: A performance fix never flushes Redis. The eval scan counts any hit.

frappe-same-key-assigned-twice.reason: Generic lint (duplicate dict key); no Frappe idiom to teach. The eval scan counts any hit.

frappe-security-file-traversal.reason: Manual-audit advisory on any file access; a performance fix does not read files. The eval scan counts any hit.

frappe-setuser.note: partial: the guardrail blocks switching to Administrator; any other set_user only by the eval scan

frappe-ssti.reason: A performance fix never renders templates. The eval scan counts any hit.

frappe-test-whitelist-missing-protection.reason: Scoped to test files; AI fixes and recipes never write tests.

frappe-translated-values-in-business-log.reason: JavaScript/JSON rule; AI fixes and recipes are Python for server-side code.

frappe-translation-js-formatting.reason: JavaScript/JSON rule; AI fixes and recipes are Python for server-side code.

frappe-translation-js-splitting.reason: JavaScript/JSON rule; AI fixes and recipes are Python for server-side code.

override-doctype-class.reason: Scoped to hooks.py; a performance fix never overrides a DocType class. The eval scan wraps code as a DocType module, so it cannot fire here.

overusing-args.reason: Signature style rule; a performance fix keeps the signature of the code it edits. The eval scan still counts any hit.

relaxed-permissions.reason: DocType permission JSON; AI fixes never emit DocType JSON.

use-vanilla-js-include.reason: JavaScript/JSON rule; AI fixes and recipes are Python for server-side code.

useless-get-doc-dict.reason: Style only (same behaviour). No product check; the eval scan counts any hit.
